overview.heading: The brand behind everything
overview.description: Everything Vekoo generates reads from here: colors, fonts, voice and the facts of your operation. Fill it in once and every carousel comes out looking like you.
overview.publishNothing: Nothing changed since the last publish.
overview.publishIncomplete: The minimum isn't filled in yet.
overview.readyDescription: The minimum is filled in and published. Generations will read this version.
overview.notReadyDescription: Complete the minimum below and publish to unlock generation.

blockers.notPublished: The brand hasn't been published yet.
blockers.minimumNotMet: The published version is missing the minimum.

overview.versionsEmpty: The first publish opens the history.
overview.versionByUnknown: by someone who left the account

colors.description: The palette, with a role for each color.

styles.description: Size, weight and color for each text role.

identity.name: Brand name
identity.conceptHint: One sentence that sums up why the brand exists.
identity.conceptPlaceholder: E.g. Sourdough bread, every day, no rush.
identity.positioningPlaceholder: How the brand wants to be seen and by whom — a short paragraph.
identity.charactersHint: Who shows up in the content: the founder, the baker, the mascot. Optional.
identity.characterRolePlaceholder: E.g. Founder, speaks in first person
identity.addressPlaceholder: Street, neighborhood, city — or just the city

colors.intro: Every color has a role. The role, not the name, tells Vekoo where to use it.
colors.starterHint: Five neutral colors with the right roles — swap each one for yours.
colors.name: Name

rules.background: At least one background (dark or light).
rules.textPerBackground: One text color for each background.

colors.previewEmpty: Add a background and a text color to see the pairs.
colors.previewMissingText: Missing the text for this background
colors.previewBodySample: Body text looks like this on this background.

typography.intro: Two fonts are enough: one that calls (display) and one that explains (utility).
typography.weightsHint: Check only the ones the brand really uses.
typography.usagePlaceholder: E.g. headlines, big numbers and covers
typography.previewSample: Write clearly and you sell without shouting.
typography.rulesHint: What the AI must never do with the text. Optional.

styles.intro: Text roles come pre-filled. Adjust size, weight and the color on each background — no need to create anything.

keyHints.kicker: The short line above the title.
keyHints.title: What gets read first.
keyHints.lede: The sentence that pulls into the body.

assets.intro: Official assets come in as files and are never recreated by approximation. Logo and glyph as transparent PNG or SVG.
assets.slotHint: Transparent PNG or SVG, up to {{max}}
assets.photosHint: Products, team, space — what the AI may use as an official image. JPEG, PNG or WebP.
assets.opaqueWarning: This PNG has a filled background. The logo will show up with a rectangle behind it — upload a version with a transparent background.
assets.confirmRemoveDescription: It leaves the brand. You can upload it again later.

voice.essenceHint: One sentence: how the brand speaks on its best day.
voice.essencePlaceholder: E.g. Explains like a friend who knows the subject: clear, direct, with an example at hand.
voice.tonesHint: Check the ones that fit. Two or three usually do.
voice.toneNotePlaceholder: E.g. can joke, but never at the expense of beginners.
voice.bannedHint: What the brand never writes. The AI obeys.
voice.examplesHint: Snippets the brand already published and liked. Optional, but it teaches a lot.
voice.examplePlaceholder: Paste a text that represents the brand well.

rules.maxOneAntithesis: At most one antithesis per piece
rules.noStackedExclamation: Never more than one exclamation mark

card.title: Brand card
card.hint: Your brand taking shape, from what you've filled in.
card.noConcept: The core concept shows up here.
card.noVoice: The voice essence shows up here.

nudge.title: Your brand isn't ready yet
nudge.description: Fill in the minimum and publish so carousels come out looking like you.

review.title: Review and publish
review.description: Check the card and publish. After the first publish, every change becomes a new version.

notes.intro: What's left after the products: opening hours, address, internal rules. Free text and optional.
notes.label: Brand notes
notes.placeholder:
E.g.:
Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–6pm
Replies to DMs within one business day
Never posts “good morning” filler
notes.hint: Kept with the brand, for reference.
notes.asideBody: It counts as context when writing a piece. Prices and offers, though, live in the previous step — there they sit in separate fields, and the assistant gets them right more often.

offers.intro: List what the brand sells. Every price and date on a piece comes from here — without this list the assistant asks instead of inventing.
offers.emptyDescription: A service, a plan, a dish, a course. The name alone already helps; price and validity help more.
offers.name: Name
offers.priceHint: Write it the way you'd say it.
offers.descriptionPlaceholder: E.g. Four live sessions a month, with the content plan reviewed together.
offers.validityHint: Validity, weekday, event date — free text.
offers.validityPlaceholder: E.g. October cohort, sign-ups until September 15
offers.asideBody: Nothing here is required and nothing blocks publishing the brand. The assistant reads this list to write the right number; if the fact isn't here, it asks.
